source: RED-Green Belt Siem Reap network, facilitated with support from GIZ (German development cooperation) and Cambodian government partners, trifold brochure "វិធីដាំខ្នុរ" (How to Plant Jackfruit); practical training content credited to Ms. Chan Vin (អ្នកស្រី ចាន់វិន), a fruit-tree seedling vendor near Boeung Tonle Vil, Siem Reap; no publication date visible on the document.
text:
About 1 month after planting, cut/remove low side-shoots or suckers from the young tree.

During the rainy season, manage water around the tree to prevent waterlogging/flooding at the base.

At the start of the dry season, mound soil at the base of the tree and apply NPK 15-15-15 fertilizer at about 30 grams per tree, mixed with cow, chicken, and pig manure, then water it in.

If the young tree shows signs of pest damage, an insecticide called S85 (active ingredient Carbaryl) is used as a control measure. The exact target pest and precise application details for this part of the source text were not fully legible and are not reconstructed here to avoid inaccuracy — treat this as a general note that S85/Carbaryl was mentioned as a pest-control product for young jackfruit trees, not a confirmed dosage or target pest.
